chapter: Chicago, Lee Collins and the road
title: The railroads and inter-urban trains at Federal Street
summary: Danny recalls the many trains at Federal Street, his first taste of Chicago.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Yeah. All right, now we go... State, Federal, what's the next one?
There was the railroad tracks over there.
Well, you got State, then you had Dearborn...

Yes. Right there on Federal, that was where all them inter-urban trains come in. I'd never seen that many trains! Every minute a train's pulling out, and one's coming in, one going out, and one... I said what...
That was the New York Central.
One was kind of kind of urban.
